summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: @servicetitan/marketing-direct-mail-components 20.1.7 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers and indirected method dispatch) and downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13`, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscated payload (string-array rotation via `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers throughout, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose contents are unrelated to the advertised React/UI component library purpose. Executing an opaque bundled payload under a freshly-downloaded second runtime at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the choice of Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-oriented supply-chain inspection. This behavior fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
